english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list. You are exempt only after 3+ years of study at a university that WHED lists with English as its only language of instruction (valid for two years after graduation); medium-of-instruction letters are not accepted.
english_waiver.quote: You have completed three or more years of post-secondary education, or completed a graduate degree at a university where English is listed as the only language of instruction on the International Association of Universities World Higher Education Database (WHED). | Note: ELP exemption from a WHED institution expires two years after graduation. | Letters from your university stating the medium of instruction is English do not satisfy Waterloo admission requirements.

notes: TOEFL scores on program pages use the new 1-6 TOEFL scale. Doctoral admission needs at least a 75% standing in the previous degree.
